text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fortunately, Ines Fujin got off with only 
slight swelling in her leg, avoiding 
anything serious. Even so, she decided to 
return home just in case to recuperate.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ines Fujin, having completed her 
recuperation, offered, "I want to learn 
how to run without collapsing after the 
race."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's a sudden proposal, but it's worth 
trying. To ensure she runs the upcoming 
Kikuka Sho safely, we decided to focus on 
this during the summer training camp.
